item.title: Hims & Hers launches copy of Wegovy pill, prompting legal threats from drugmaker Novo Nordisk
item.description: By MATTHEW PERRONE WASHINGTON (AP) — Telehealth company Hims & Hers said Thursday it will launch a cheaper, off-brand version of the weight-loss pill Wegovy, just weeks after drugmaker Novo Nordisk launched its highly anticipated reformulation of the blockbuster medication. The announcement from Hims is the latest example of the company’s efforts to capitalize on […]

item.title: 1917 Book Club will discuss book of stories by RMNP ranger
item.description: On Wednesday, Feb. 18, 2026, the 1917 Book Club, hosted by the Estes Park Museum, will explore the local title "Recollections of a Rocky Mountain Ranger," by Jack Moomaw. The program will take place from 10 to 11:30 a.m. in the Museum Meeting Room.

item.title: Parade will kick off Estes Park’s Rooftop Rodeo on July 6
item.description: The Rooftop Rodeo Parade will kick off 2026 Rooftop Rodeo week at 10 a.m. Monday, July 6, with the parade route starting at Performance Park, traveling down Elkhorn, and ending at the fairgrounds at 1125 Rooftop Way.

item.title: US announces $6M in aid for Cuba as island’s leader accuses it of imposing an ‘energy blockade’
item.description: The aid is largely meant for those affected by Hurricane Melissa last year.

item.title: A newborn’s death likely linked to the mom drinking raw milk while pregnant
item.description: State officials have warned people to avoid consuming unpasteurized dairy products following the death.

item.title: Freight train derails in Connecticut, sending cars carrying liquid propane into river
item.description: Officials say four of the train's car carrying liquid propane ended up in the water.

item.title: Families of plane crash victims ask US appeals court to revive a criminal case against Boeing
item.description: The families maintain prosecutors violated their rights by failing to consult them properly.

item.title: Republicans reject complaint about Gabbard as Democrats question time it took to see it
item.description: The top Democrat on the House Intelligence Committee said he will keep looking into it.

item.title: A Colorado funeral home stashed 189 decaying bodies and handed out fake ashes. His mother was among them.
item.description: Return to Nature funeral home co-owner Jon Hallford will be sentenced Friday, facing between 30 to 50 years in prison.

item.title: Census Bureau plans to use survey with a citizenship question in its test for 2030, alarming experts
item.description: The ACS includes a citizenship question while the census form does not.
